blurb: This private Niagara Falls experience provides a seamless day trip with pickup and drop-off anywhere in the GTA, from your hotel, home, or the airport. In this tour, you will enjoy a scenic drive along the Niagara Parkway, one of the most beautiful drives in the world, with stops at Niagara-on-the-Lake, the Floral Clock, Queen’s Park, and Whirlpool Rapids. Once in Niagara, this tour provides time to visit the Table Rock for breathtaking Falls views, ride to the Skylon Tower observation deck, stroll lively Clifton Hill, and step into the excitement of Fallsview Casino. You may also add attractions such as the Hornblower Cruise, Journey Behind the Falls, White Water Walk, Whirlpool Aero Car, or Niagara Fly Theatre.Best of all, this tour is fully customizable from departure to return,the entire 10 hours are yours.Your private driver is just a call or text away, ready to take you to each stop. Designed as a private journey, this tour blends flexibility, comfort, and unforgettable memories.
